exclusions.title: Additional confirmed project · Alves Painting video
exclusions.reason: The painter’s July 18, 2025 video caption identifies Retreat SW 6207. In a reply to a viewer questioning the color, the painter explicitly reconfirms it. This is a real project video; it is linked here for further viewing and is not counted as a saved still photograph.

exclusions.title: Before photos and duplicate reposts
exclusions.reason: Removed Lancaster’s three old-color/preparation slides, Inspired Style’s old-color views, Lynda Davis’s red-siding before view, PAINT CORPS before photos, and repeated image sizes. Reposts of Riley, Archival Bungalow, Inspired Style and Franks on the Lake count only once per distinct view.

exclusions.title: Sunset Hill: alternative paint visualizations
exclusions.reason: The article contains numerous digitally colored alternatives and painted sample experiments. The actual finished-house photo is explicitly labeled by the owner and is included; the alternatives are omitted.

exclusions.title: Mill Pond Cottage: landscape-only pictures
exclusions.reason: Most later garden and sale images do not show enough of the painted house to serve as exterior color references. Twelve useful house/studio views remain. The matching studio is grouped with the house as one project.

exclusions.title: East & Lane coastal bungalow
exclusions.reason: A real house photo appears in broad search results, but the tour does not establish Retreat as its exterior paint. Its interior paint information cannot verify the outside color.

exclusions.title: Williamson Building & Remodeling: Branchport cottage
exclusions.reason: The word retreat refers to a lakeside home. The contractor describes a brilliant blue exterior and does not identify SW 6207. This is a search false match.

exclusions.title: Houzz: Kathy Roe homeowner comment
exclusions.reason: A homeowner explicitly names Retreat with Alabaster, but no house photo is attached to that comment. Other commenters’ photographs show unrelated paint colors; none were assigned to this owner.

exclusions.title: Digital paint concepts and generated exteriors
exclusions.reason: Hackrea labels its concepts digital visualizations. Housepaint AI, PaintVue and comparable recolorings are also excluded from the documentary collection. Colorxs mixes a credited real house with mockup images; only the credited house is represented here through another source.

exclusions.title: GC Design Build video lead
exclusions.reason: The March 24, 2025 caption discusses Retreat. The accessible reel page did not display usable project imagery, so no photograph is counted from it.

exclusions.title: Houzz: Craftsman paint questions
exclusions.reason: The original question asks for the siding brand and color. An answer was not available in the accessible page. The related photo is retained in the unresolved category, not elevated to a confirmed paint example.

exclusions.title: Color schedules, samples and planning requests
exclusions.reason: An available color scheme, swatch or proposed finish does not prove that a photographed real house was painted in that color. These are not counted as completed paint photographs.

methodology: Searched public text and image results using Retreat, Sherwin-Williams, SW 6207/SW6207, exterior, siding, house, painting, before/after and homeowner terms. Checked contractor portfolios, designer reveals, original homeowner journals, social carousels, Houzz discussions, credited design publications and manufacturer material. Followed project links and later updates, inspected downloaded photographs, and compared reposts to remove known duplicates. Source-confirmed means an original painter, designer or homeowner identifies the applied color; secondary attributions remain separate. Distinct angles and useful details remain. The confirmed set includes a two-photo composite counted as one asset, construction-stage photos and two later door-maintenance photos showing existing siding. The matching Mill Pond studio is grouped with the main house. Private, deleted, unindexed, login-restricted and inaccessible posts can contain more photographs. This is a thorough public-web collection, not a guarantee of every photo in existence.
